text:
alex: Quick check — our contract tests started failing for /v2/generate: schema linter flags `metadata` as null in some responses. Repro: one response had "metadata": null.

 t ess: that's surprising. API contract says `metadata` is optional and should be omitted if empty. We shouldn't return null, clients treat null differently.

 sam: I saw this in canary logs too. Looks like the model adapter returns null for empty KV fields. Repro snippet from logs:
```
{"id":"abc","text":"hi","metadata":null}
```

 maria: Agree we shouldn't change the contract silently. Options: 1) update schema to allow null, 2) change runtime to drop null fields before serializing.

 alex: leaning runtime strip. Less impact to clients. Any perf concerns for an extra cleanup pass?

 tess: trivial CPU cost, it's just serialization. We already run a structured-output serializer. We'll add a `drop_nulls` pass for structured responses behind a feature flag.

 ryan: For safety, add a CI lint that fails if examples include `metadata: null` and add an acceptance test in `contract-tests`. Also record a regression test for streaming NDJSON boundary cases.

 dev-bot: CI: contract-tests pipeline triggered for branch fix/strip-null -> failing on canary: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4892 (logs attached).

 alex: I'll open a PR that: 1) adds the drop-null pass in runtime, 2) adds contract-tests acceptance case, 3) updates SDK mapping docs (map null -> absent). Assigning @tess for review. ETA EOD.

 tess: ack, will review. Also flagging SDK owners to map null->undefined to avoid client breakage.

 maria: small doc ask — add note under API behavior about `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` and structured output expectations (omit empty fields). Also mention streaming: ensure NDJSON chunker doesn't emit an empty `
` that leads to a `null` token.

 alex: thanks all :thumbsup: 

 // action items summary:
 // - alex: PR runtime + tests + docs
 // - tess: review PR + coordinate SDK owners
 // - ryan: add CI lint rule + acceptance tests
 // - maria: update API docs + changelog note
